The chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at ncd: the pair (ncd, qnb) comes first; its second item is qnb, so the next pair is the one whose first item is qnb: (qnb, rst). Its second item is rst, but rst never appears as a first item - so rst is the dangling end of the chain.

ANSWER: ncd, qnb, rst, ...
